Name: Mermaid's Bracelet Recolor
Author: alger0210
Description:
修改了SVE中法师赠送给你的美人鱼手镯
Changed the mermaid bracelet SVE gave you
去掉了彩色的巨大珠子，改用金色小珠子和紫色小珠子代替
The large colored beads were removed and replaced with small gold beads and small purple beads
图上效果是添加了焦糖色滤镜，所以看不出紫色小珠子，但不添加焦糖色滤镜紫色小珠子应该很明显
Home image effect is added caramel color filter, so the purple beads are not visible, but without caramel color filter the purple beads should be obvious
紫色小珠子代表法师，所以我添加了这个颜色
The purple beads represent the Wizard, so I added this color
[color=#980000][size=5]
你只会获得一张图片，需要放进SVE里边替换
You will only get one image, which needs to be replaced in the SVE[/size][/color]
